scope: Local shared ARM64 Mac/Docker capacity search; no official x86 rank or all-competitor claim.
interpretation: Only a qualified300s hold yields a local held-user score. Ceiling/budget bounds are censored lower bounds, not proved maxima. Invalid generator/clock phases never become server failures or capacity scores. Native SLO permits<1% measured errors; zero errors and recorded ramp/tail errors are separate. This ARM Mac study cannot establish the official x86 leaderboard rank. Preregistered local qualification substitutes measured external-client cgroup CPU≤75% for the native whole-VM /proc/stat CPU flag only. All native timing/active-user gates remain. Native verdicts are preserved separately; a local score may remain native LG-limited and is not an official/native-qualified score.
